title: ScreeningResultSchema
description: Schema representing the definitive, explainable outcome of the deterministic policy engine.

screening_event_id.description: Unique identifier of this screening evaluation event

outcome.description: Definitive screening decision produced by deterministic rules

reason_codes.description: Stable machine-readable audit codes (e.g. CATEGORY_RULE_ALERT, LOW_CLASSIFIER_CONFIDENCE)

matched_rule_ids.description: List of rule IDs that matched during evaluation

policy_version.description: Active policy version used for evaluation

explanation.description: Human-readable plain English explanation of the decision outcome

requires_human_review.description: True if outcome is REVIEW or ALERT or contains cautionary flags

audit_trace.description: Detailed trace of rules considered, rejected, or conflicting during evaluation
